title: 纹发际线能做什么，不能做什么
title_en: What hairline pigmentation can and cannot do
intro: 纹发际线用线条模拟毛流，在视觉上补充部分边缘与空缺；它与植发是不同的事。
intro_en: Hairline pigmentation uses hair-like lines to address some visible gaps and edges. It is different from hair transplantation.

sections.title: 顺着原生方向
sections.description: 观察鬓角、发际线边缘与原生头发的生长方向，讨论局部颜色淡、露白或边缘不连贯等问题。
sections.description_en: Study the temples, hairline edges and existing growth direction when discussing faint colour, visible gaps or uneven edges.

sections.title: 不让头发重新生长
sections.description: 它不会增加真实头发。需要明显前移发际线、大面积缺失或高额头明显降低时，不应只靠纹绣解决，应到正规医疗机构咨询适合的方案。
sections.description_en: Pigmentation does not add real hair. Substantial hairline repositioning or extensive hair loss should be discussed with an appropriate medical provider rather than relying on pigmentation alone.

sections.title: 护理与留色
sections.description: 洗头、运动和日常护理的安排按实际操作部位与恢复情况确认。留色常以约2–3年作经验参考，个体差异明显；所有项目一年内免费补色。
sections.description_en: Confirm washing, exercise and aftercare around the actual treatment area and healing. Around two to three years is a retention guide, with individual variation. All services include free touch-ups within one year.
